### About Myself

I am a PhD student in Economics at McGill University. My research interests include both labour and sports economics. I am especially accustomed to using machine learning techniques to support my causal research. I have also preformed research on short-term rental markets and the economic impacts of the art industry in Canada. I have completed my MA in Economics at the University of Waterloo and my Undergraduate degree in Honors Economics at Saint Mary's University in Halifax, NS.

*For any more information on my work please reach out to me via email*
